snippet.title: Micro Titans Wrestling - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The Micro Titans Wrestlng demo is officially LIVE! Step into the ring with select stars from our original roster and get a taste of what Going Micro is all about! 💪

Micro Titans Wrestling is a nostalgia fuelled roguelike deck builder themed on the golden age of professional wrestling. Prepare to step into the ring with a roster of era defining characters and take it to the mat with a unique card battle system.

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam today! ➡️ https://bit.ly/MicroTitansWrestlingOnSteam
